name: Futanari Stories: Captured 4 U
source:
You have been working all week long, craving for the weekend. And now it is Friday and you're waiting at the bus stop to finally ride home and relax. That's when two hot girls approach you…Martina Ortega and Velvet Bane.

[From [url=http://darktoz.com/futanari-stories-captured-4-u]Official site[/url]]
translation:
你整整工作了一周，渴望周末到来。现在是星期五，你在公交车站等车，终于可以回家放松。这时，两个火辣女孩走近你……玛蒂娜·奥尔特加与天鹅绒·贝恩。
